notes: THE RULES OF THE HALL (client/scenes/pages/rules_of_the_hall.gd), from chat_rules.png. The page carries one live thing -- the rules themselves, which come from the balance (social.chat.rules) so that changing them is a publish and not a build -- and two plates that are the painting's own with a hotspot over each.
The writing area is the parchment's own continuous stretch (x 170-778, y 623-1326), measured rather than guessed: the scroll's rolled ends are painted and nothing may be written on them.
The support address is set under the rules, in the same ink: App Review 1.2 wants a way to reach a person from where the talking is.

elements.sample:
Speak as you would in your own hall.
No abuse, no hate, no threats, and nothing of a private life -- yours or another's.
No trade of accounts, gold or anything outside the realm.
